name: duration_seconds
definition: Current flow duration normalized to seconds.
causality_leakage: SAFE_FEATURE; NaN when no defensible duration field exists.

name: protocol_family
definition: Transport/protocol family.
causality_leakage: CONDITIONAL_FEATURE; Excluded from universal flow profile; usable for dataset/pair profiles.

name: connection_state
definition: Connection state/flags summary.

name: src_port
definition: Source transport port.

name: dst_port
definition: Destination transport/service port.

name: total_packets
definition: Total packet count in current flow.
causality_leakage: SAFE_FEATURE; NaN for Edge prepared CSV and N-BaIoT.

name: fwd_packets
definition: Forward/source packet count in current flow.

name: bwd_packets
definition: Backward/destination packet count in current flow.

name: total_bytes
definition: Total bytes/length observed for current record.
causality_leakage: SAFE_FEATURE; NaN when no length field exists.

name: fwd_bytes
definition: Forward/source bytes.

name: bwd_bytes
definition: Backward/destination bytes.

name: bytes_per_second
definition: Current flow byte rate.

name: packets_per_second
definition: Current flow packet rate.

name: packet_length_mean
definition: Mean/current packet length statistic.
causality_leakage: CONDITIONAL_FEATURE; NaN when unavailable; Edge proxy documented.

name: packet_length_std
definition: Packet length standard deviation within current flow.

name: packet_length_min
definition: Minimum packet length in current flow.

name: packet_length_max
definition: Maximum packet length in current flow.

name: flow_iat_mean
definition: Source-provided mean inter-arrival time within flow.

name: flow_iat_std
definition: Source-provided inter-arrival variability within flow.

name: source_provided_delta_seconds
definition: Source-provided packet/UDP delta time when available.

name: timestamp_start
definition: Start timestamp for ordering/causal feature generation.

name: source_host
definition: Source entity key for causal behavioral feature generation.
causality_leakage: USED_FOR_GROUPING_FEATURE_GENERATION; Metadata only, never direct model input.

name: destination_host
definition: Destination entity key for causal behavioral feature generation.
causality_leakage: USED_FOR_GROUPING_FEATURE_GENERATION; Metadata only, never direct model input.

name: traffic_asymmetry
definition: Directional byte imbalance for current flow: (forward - backward) / total bytes.
causality_leakage: SAFE_FEATURE; NaN when directional bytes unavailable.

name: packet_direction_ratio
definition: Forward/backward packet count ratio for current flow.

name: source_agg_*
definition: N-BaIoT source-provided KitNET damped-window host/host-pair traffic behavior statistics over historical decay windows.
